transcript:
Council Room
Monday Session July 4th 58M 1870.
City Council met pursuant to adjournment
His Honor Leander Bowers Mayor in the Chair, Roll called and the following Aldermen
answered to their Names: Aldermen Bennett, Baker, Raven, Demosthe Etc. Minutes of the
regular Meeting are called as things read and adopted The committee on Ordinance in
reference to Houses of ill fame, reported in favor of the same except Sections 3 and 4.
Report of the Committee received and
adopted and said Committee discharged from further
Consideration of the same.
Sections Report for June was read and
received
The Ordinance was then read, Section by
Section and passed to first reading
Resolved that the Mayor be requested
to Consult the Governor and other good Authorities upon the Constitutionality of the 5th
Section, and report at the next Meeting of the City Council.
Resolved that the Mayor be requested to ask the Governor, whether he will appoint a City
Marshal, or whether he will Authorize the City Council to name a Suitable person for the
Office
The Council adjourned until the next
regular Meeting.
A O Horne
Recorder
The Minutes of the regular Meeting of the
Council of the 4th of July Continued
List of Appropriation for the Month of June M W Herwick Policeman Month of June 40 00
Mr N Fletcher do do do 40 00
N B Smith do do do 40 00
Ezee Carrington Taken care of Engine 6 00 George B Gentleman feeding prisoners 29 00
Porter Hire for 5 Months 15 00
Butler and Raymond for Stationary 13 75
Jas W Smith City Attorney Month of May 9 33 The above appropriation was made [illegible]
Total $184 08 Council Adjourned AC
